balls.text: he also gets a short and slow ball, pulls to the leg side with protection in the deep and it lands well short of the deep midwicket fielder who sprinted in. Two to end the innings by the time it's picked up
Too high off Miller's pull as Behrendorff pitches it slow again, Miller swings because that's the only way to go now, mistimes it, and SKY settles under it after coming inside from the rope
a rare dot ball. Knuckle ball on length, and goes just over over stump past Miller's swing
114.3kmh, slow and short again, Tewatia mistimes the pull this time for one and has twisted his back foot on the pivot. Hope it's nothing big. He is stretching it and looks ok
Tewatia playing with the field too, another six! Fine leg is in, he shuffles across a long way for the short and slow ball at 112.1kmh, and pull-scoops it over fine leg for a six
wide full toss around off, Tewatia laps it up and slaps it over the wide long-on boundary. Guess what, six more!
tries a slower one but its' gone wrong down leg for a wide. Mumbai review it. That one went straight down to the keeper, remains a wide

on the other side now, make that two sixes in a row for the third six of the over! Outside off, not too wide but enough width for Miller to free his arms, smash that over the covers and land another one in the crowd
pulled on the leg side, Behrendorff gets both hands to it, but he is too close to the top and wants to throw it back in, but he doesn't even catch it properly, and it goes over for six!
takes the pace off and angles it across Miller, who chases and misses
wide and low full toss outside off, this time he pushes it down to long-off for one
he loves that leg-side boundary doesn't he? Shuffles a mile across off, Meredith follows him by going very wide too, but Tewatia wins by sweeping it in the bag gap on the leg side for six

nobody gets it right and Manohar falls! Meredith doesn't get the yorker right and sends down a low full toss on the pads. On another day, Manohar would have smoked it over the ropes on the leg side but he decides to go inside out and down the ground, doesn't get much distance and finds long-off

a six from Miller too! Mumbai leaking runs in the death overs yet again, 22 from this one. Makes just a little bit of room, gets one in the slot on the stumps and nails that loft down the ground between long-off and long-on for another clean six
attempts the yorker and Miller flicks it off his shoes in the gap on leg for two
1402.kmh, full and wide, he scythes it behind square in the air but it reaches deep third after a bounce

over long-off this time, six more! Clean hitting from Manohar, and he's demolishing everything. Not quite in the slot but it doesn't matter, his swing is so big and powerful down the ground, it clears long-off
monstrous six! That's gone miles in the air and beyond the midwicket boundary! Short ball, pulled with disdain right off the middle, and hands the crowd the ball with a big shot
leading edge on the leg side as Miller pulls the short ball, gets a top edge towards backward square but there's nobody there. What luck
excellent ball in the block hole outside off, he digs it out to point for one
slower at 113kmh, but it's too wide outside off and with that much width, Miller could have moved a few metres to off and still slammed it square for a boundary
112.6kmh, another slower one on the stumps and Manohar works it down to long-on
136,6kmh! Got to feel for Meredith there. He nails the yorker, Manohar scythes it straight to short third where Chawla lets it slip through. Rohit is fuming!
111.4kmh, slower to Manohar as well on middle and leg and he cleverly pushes it down to long-on with soft hands to return for two
slower one angling across well outside off, he slams it to deep cover
ends the over with a short ball near Manohar's face and he goes down for a ramp but misses
gets some with and spots the slower one, drives through the covers for two more
he makes room and comes down too, Behrendorff bowls it slightly slower at 129kmh and follows him too, Miller ends up scything it to point
bowls a short ball not surprisingly with protection in the deep but it's down leg for a wide
110.4kmh, slower ball just outside off and Manohar gets another single towards backward point
short of length, Miller pulls to the man in the deep on leg for one
short of length around off and he helps it towards point for a quick single
slightly shorter and Manohar works it square for one

charges down, takes it on the full and Manohar has whacked that very high down the ground, the crowd gets on its feet immediately because they know it's going all the way for six! What an attack from Manohar in Chawla's last over
some flight on middle and Miller helps it down to long-off for one
pulls the length back and he slices it square for one
almost a replay with another full ball from Chawla, and Manohar slams it all along the ground again with another booming drive for four
too full outside off, right in the slow with some width and Manohar blasts that along the ground through the gap in the covers for a powerful boundary
flat again and slightly tighter, Manohar slices it past point for one
flatter and shorter around off, he scythes it to point
another left-arm orthodox ball and he works it down to long-on for one more
back to orthodox spin around middle, he helps it to midwicket
a full legbreak in the slot around off, Miller is not going to leave that! Smokes that down the ground and clears long-off by a distance
towards middle and leg, and Miller nudges it behind square for two
looked like a flat googly or slider outside off, Miller pushes to cover and takes off for a quick single
full and flighted well outside off, Manohar gets a single down to long-on
some drift for the full ball coming in, pretty full too, and he finds cover again
lunges forward for a drive and finds cover

Shankar holes out to long-on too! The Titans batters are perishing while trying to clear the straight boundary off the spinners. Shankar wants to clear long-on off the flighted and full ball, swing down, but can't clear David's bucket hands there

falls just short of deep cover! Shankar drove on the up with the spin from outside off, went for a big drive, and Behrendorff ran in to dive forward as well, couldn't make it, and did well to stop the ball meanwhile
Miller gets going! Gets what looked like Kartikeya's slowest ball of the day at 77.5kmh, it was full as well in the slot, and he slammed it back over the bowler's head for a powerful four
goes back for the length ball as well, and Shankar works it to leg once again for one
outside off and Miller steers it square on off for one
goes back for the shorter ball and helps it to leg for one
flat delivery on the stumps, Miller tucks it to leg for one

Kartikeya gets the big wicket of Gill! Full on middle from wide of the crease, Gill goes downtown and like Pandya, he can't clear SKY at the boundary, but this time at long-on and well inside the rope
comes down for a big shot, Meredith slows it down, and Gill pulls to long-on. Keeps strike too

drilled straight back past the bowler, the umpire, the non-striker, and it's bisected long-on and long-off. Stunning shot. Gill is in imperious form here. The bowler errs with a full ball on the stumps and he punishes immediately
143.2kmh, nearly in the block hole and digs it out to long-on
the first bouncer of the game which Shankar leaves alone. One for the over
nice and tight on off stump, Shankar steers to point and is sent back for the single
short of length on off, worked to leg easily for one
drives this down to long-off and it's his fifty off 30 balls
97.5kmh, it looked slower than that and must have been slower for Gill because he sees that full ball on middle and mows it to the wide long-on boundary for his sixth four
goes back and nudges the length ball on the stumps to leg for one
clears long-off with a swing! Pitched up, swung down, and initially it looked like he didn't get enough distance by going against the turn, but he middled it very well
strays too much down leg, Shankar tickles it pretty fine with a leg glance and fine enough to beat Tendulkar for four
loud appeal from the bowler as Shankar goes back to help the ball to leg but it was struck around leg on the back foot. Rohit doesn't review after consulting the bowler
Shankar lofts the full ball down to long-on for one
comes down for another big swing but Chawla pitches it on middle and leg, and Gill gets a leading edge along the ground to deep midwicket
shorter, flatter and quicker on the pads at 92.7kmh, Gill wants to swat it away but gets two towards shirt fine region for two
a lot more flight around off, he waits and drives to cover
slightly slower on the stumps, pushes it back

dances down and drills it through the covers! Gill is playing some stunning shots here. He takes on the in-form bowler by coming down and taking it on the full outside off, and middles the booming drive
length ball on off and Shankar defends it back
beaten with bounce and turn! Slows it down to 84.6kmh outside off, Shankar wants to play with a straight bat but the turn beats his outside edge completely
angling in towards the pads, works towards midwicket for one
flat and outside off, slices it straight to short third
two more as this time Gill gets some width outside off and punches it through the covers
starts with a flat length ball and it's nudged to leg for two in the gap
89.8km, some turn on off stump and it's driven down along the carpet to long-off
90.5kmh, length ball on the stumps and Shankar pushes it down to long-on for one
the wrong'un towards the pads as Gill comes down, he works it square with the spin to leg for one
shorter around off and turning away, Gill pulls it gently and can't clear short midwicket
off the mark by driving the full ball down to long-off along the drive
luckily gets a wide down leg after missing the sweep

wicket first ball for Chawla! He gets the captain out straightaway. Pitches it up fearlessly with long-on at the rope, Pandya goes after it with a big swing but he can't clear long-off. SKY leaps just inside the rope and takes it with both hands above his head. Well judged by him
ends the over on the pads and Pandya flicks it away along the ground to deep midwicket
outside off and short of length, Gill gets a single towards mid-off with an edge

shot of the match so far! Tendulkar - the senior one - will be proud of that straight drive. Gets a length ball, maybe he was expecting that, and lofts that straight down with impeccable timing over mid-on. The crowd is loving it
two in a row, Gill wants to cash in on the last powerplay over. Makes room, Green takes the pace off outside off and Gill adjusts well to scythe that away past cover point for four more
short ball and smoked for four! Not too short, but Gill seems to have enough time to wait and unleash a pull between mid-on and midwicket
short of length on the stumps to begin with, worked to leg for one
shorter on middle, Gill goes across and nudges it quite wide of short fine leg and asks for two immediately
tries a slower one variation at 117.7kmh, down leg for a wide
141.3kmh, Gill stays back and punches the length ball from outside off to cover point
142.3kmh, nice and straight with some inswing towards middle and leg, punches it down to the right of mid-on

one bounce to mid-on and Pandya just makes it for the single! Gill swung down on the up and David swooped in for a throw at the keeper's end and replays show Pandya would have made it had it been a direct hit
142.4kmh, errs down the leg side for a wide
drives on the up, gets a leading edge over the cover point region and the edge is thick enough for the ball to roll all the way. It was a length ball on fifth stump with a hint of away movement
141kmh, starts with a length ball on the stumps and Gill whacks it to short midwicket
smacked for four! A bit too short and Pandya was almost waiting on the back foot to pivot and pull with disdain to the midwicket boundary
on Gill's pads as well and he nudges it to the leg side for one
a bit more on the pads and Pandya works it square for one after three dots
134.2kmh, pitched up on middle, driven straight down and back to the bowler
pitched up slightly on middle and leg and he pushes it down to mid-on
on middle and leg, Pandya tickles it fine but straight to short fine leg
on the pads again, shortish too, and Pandya helps it down to fine leg for one. Keeps strike

bit too short outside off, not much room but it's enough for Pandya to hang back and punch it away off the middle through the covers in the gap before Green chases it down and saves two just inside the rope
there comes the big shot after three dots. Tendulkar pitches on leg, Pandya flicks it away in the air with a big flourish but there's deep midwicket there who keeps it to two
130.3kmh, bit more on the pads and Pandya nudges it to midwicket
starts with a straight drive and can't get off the mark because mid-off dives and saves a few

misses the pull down leg, Tendulkar and gang think there's an edge and appeal for caught behind, given out on the field, Saha goes down to Gill for advice and reviews it just in time! It was short on leg and swung down a touch, Saha went for the pull behind square, and UltraEdge shows there's a spike when the ball is around the glove. I wonder how Saha didn't know that, but it's possible
shortish again and a hint of room outside off with the angle, Saha runs it down to deep third and keeps strike
stays back and tickles the short of length ball to the right of mid-on for one more
drives on the up, maybe that's what Mumbai are looking for, and Gill gets two in the covers
the first boundary of the game because Behrendorff has erred slightly on the pads with a short of length ball and Gill stays back to work it off his hips behind square on the leg side in the big gap
going across at 137kmh from off stump, Gill goes for a drive and misses
starts with a length ball on off and Gill defends it too
good ball to end the over. On length on off with a hint of inswing again, Saha defends off the back foot to off
128.8kmh, short and going across, Saha looks for a pre-meditated pull and misses
flicks the length ball in the air but safe towards deep backward square for one more
touch shorter, no swing and Saha runs it down just past short third with a late dab and Chawla hares down to the boundary before keeping the ball just inside with a dive. Saves one
more inswing as Tendulkar goes a touch wider and pitches it on length again on off, Saha keeps his bat close to pad again to block
nice and accurate first up around off stump with a hint of inswing, Saha defends patiently
Full on middle and going across. Meredith goes across and has a swish and misses as Gujarat Titans complete a comprehensive victory
Short on off, Meredith backs away and slaps it back to the bowler

Picks out long-on now and that will be the end of Arjun Tendulkar's debut innings in the IPL. Full and wide and he reaches out and looks to muscle this away but didn't get a clean connection at all. It's a simple catch for Josh Little
Full and wide, he swings and misses. Tendulkar reviews it for a wide but the third umpire upholds the on-field decision
Looks to swing big again as he gets a full delivery but gets an inside edge that goes past short fine. Deep backward square runs in to stop the boundary
Banged in short and Tendulkar has hit it all the way! Pulled away with disdain over deep square leg!
Full on off, he drives to extra cover
Short and he pulls it to deep midwicket on the bounce
Full on off, he plays it wide of mid-off and takes off for the single. A direct hit at the non-striker's could have had Behrendorff in trouble, but the throw was wide
Full and wide, he tries to drive through the off side but is beaten on the outside edge
Banged in short on off and going across, Tendulkar pulls it behind to deep fine leg
Full and wide, he slashes at it and the ball loops up between short third and backward square and lands safe between the two Afghans who were fielding there
Short outside off, he taps it behind square on the off-side and races off for the single

Mohit Sharma gets a wicket now. Full outside off, Wadhera goes across to ramp it and picks out Shami at short fine. Mohit casually asks for the ball back. That's about as nonchalant a wicket celebration in a winning cause as I have seen as Wadhera walks back having made 40 off 21
Short on off and going across, Tendulkar punches it through square and gets off the mark
More confusion as Wadhera pulls it behind square and just stands there as Arjun Tendulkar goes for the run. Wadhera has enough time to run to the non-striker's

Oops! It's a run-out! It's full and wide and Chawla has left it. Wadhera had run all the way with Chawla not even interested. Saha throws it back to Mohit Sharma who calmly walks back to the stumps at the non-striker's end and takes a bail off. Replays confirm Wadhera had crossed Chawla, so it's Chawla who will have to go back

Oh Shami won't like that! It's a very low full toss that Wadhera gets his bat down on and pings the ball wide of mid-off where it goes through Hardik Pandya and goes for four, slightly ruining Shami's excellent figures. He finishes with 0-18 nonetheless from his four
Banged in short and Chawla backs away and looks to pull. The edge takes it high in the air again and lands in no man's land this time
Nails another yorker this time, on leg, and Chawla jams his bat down in time to dig it back to the bowler
Another bouncer honing in on Chawla, who tries to ramp but the ball flies over

Dropped by Hardik running back from mid-off! Banged in short outside off and he has a swipe at it. It goes high in the air and Hardik tried to take it reverse-cupped above head height and he can't hold on as he falls back
Nails the yorker outside off and Wadhera can only dig it back out to Shami
Full slower ball outside off, he drives it wide of long-off where Rashid Khan collects
Full outside off, he swings it along the ground to deep midwicket
On a length on leg, he backs away and whips it to deep midwicket
And now Piyush Chawla joins the party! It's full and wide and he has a mighty swing. It hits the toe end of the bat but he hit it with enough power to clear long-on
In the air again and Saha can't hold on! Moves across to a full slower ball outside off and tries to ramp it. Doesn't get it cleanly and Saha is running back and is at full stretch but can't take it

Full toss on leg, Wadhera looks to flick this away. This goes hiiiigh in the air but it has also gone the distance! It may be too late and probably too little, but Wadhera is giving Mumbai Indians something to be happy about
On a length at 140kph around off and Wadhera clips it square
Swung over backward square and all the way! Short on off, he moves across and pulls this away. The fielder in the deep was left watching it sail over
Slapped away to sweeper cover. It's short and wide and he has a swish at it but picks the fielder in the deep
Slower ball on a length on off, Wadhera goes low and scoop-pulls it to deep backward square
Full on leg and he looks to clip it away leg-side and misses
Short and wide and Wadhera slaps it away through covers! Manohar gives chase in the deep running across, but his dive can't stop it from rolling onto the rope
Drops his pace and bowls it on a length on leg, Wadhera waits for it and lobs it up into the vacant midwicket area
On a length on leg, Chawla punches it out to long-on
Shot, Piyush Chawla! It's full outside off and he makes room and drives this between cover and mid-off. Picked the gap with aplomb!
Full and wide, he hacks it away down the ground to mid-off
On a length on middle, Chawla nicely punches it through cover and the sweeper runs across to cover
On a length on middle and going across, Wadhera swings it to deep backward square

Has he got him? Yes he has! On a length on off, SKY punches it straight back to him and Noor takes a good low catch! It was to his right and dipping on him and he dived in front with both hands to hold on to that
Wrong'un on middle and SKY goes back to cut but misses
Full toss on leg and SKY punishes it. Goes across and sweeps it through backward square. A few bounces and out
This is on a length on middle and he clips it through to deep midwicket
Goes all the way. Tossed up full outside off, Wadhera leans forward and hits it cleanly down the ground and clears long-off
Low full toss outside off but Wadhera has moved across and he can paddle this fine and it races away
And now SKY takes him for six! Full on off and he makes room and lofts it over cover. Top-ranked legspinner bowling one of his best spells? Alright then, let's hit you around for fun, says SKY!
Shot. SKY gets another boundary as he punches this googly outside off wide of long-on. Only two boundaries today off Rashid Khan, and both have come off SKY
On a length on leg, Wadhera nudges it behind square and wide of short fine
On a length on middle and going in with the angle, SKY hangs back and punches it out to wide long-on

Another attempted reverse-sweep and this time he misses. Rashid raps him on the pads and the umpire gives it out. Mumbai Indians review. Oh, looks like he got bat on it! The decision has been overturned
Oh wow. It's tossed up full outside off and SKY reverse-sweeps it so fine, it goes between the keeper and first slip!
Tossed up full outside off, Wadhera looks to drive on the off side and gets an inside edge onto his pads
Tossed up full on middle, Wadhera defends it back to the bowler

Mumbai Indians are falling like a house of cards! David goes for a huge swing across the line to a full toss and doesn't quite time it. The ball goes high in the air and Abhinav Manohar settles underneath it to send David packing for a two-ball duck
On a length on off, David plays it back to the bowler

Bowled'im! Noor Ahmad joins the party with one that goes in with the angle. It's on a length outside leg and Green goes for a big swing and misses as the ball crashes into leg stump. Noor is pumped, Gujarat Titans are in the ascendancy and Mumbai Indians are in big big trouble
On a length on middle and SKY cuts it through point to the fielder in the deep
Slow and on a length outside off, Green cuts behind point and Rashid goes through another boundary-less over
Tossed up on a length on off, he whips it wide of long-on
Slower and full outside off. SKY goes for the sweep and it it lobs up to short fine on the bounce. They take the single. He got some glove on that seemingly
Good shot, but finds the fielder. Plonks his front foot forward and slaps this full delivery down the ground but long-on runs to his left to stop that
Googly outside off and Green looks to go big. Gets an inside edge and is lucky it goes past leg stump to short fine
Tossed up on a length around off, Suryakumar punches it past short cover and wide of long-off
On a length on leg, he clips it square and gets off the mark
Full on leg and Green slams it wide of long-on along the ground. Gets just the single
Throws it up wide and Green can't connect
Wallopped down the ground. In the slot and he clubs it straight as an arrow. Just clears the rope as well
Goes for the sweep to this full ball outside leg and misses. The ball pops up off his pad
On a length on leg, Green steers it to short third

Huge appeal from Rashid Khan as Varma presses forward to defend. This time Hardik Pandya opts for the review, and in some style! It's pitching full on  leg and brushes the front pad before hitting the back pad. No bat on it. Ball-tracking shows the ball pitching just in line and hitting wickets. Rashid Khan has two in the over!
On a length on middle and off, Tilak pulls it out to deep midwicket. They do well to run two there
Tossed up on a length outside leg. Varma looks to clip it and Saha thinks there's an edge. But then Saha himself signals it was off the thighs and not bat

Kishan's difficult stay comes to an end. Looks to go for a big heave and ends up skying it. Josh Little takes it above head height. It was high in the air and a tough catch, but he made it look simple. It was a wrong'un and dropped short but Kishan couldn't quite time it
Massive appeal from Rashid Khan as a legbreak on length around leg raps Kishan on the pads. They opt against the review. Could have been turning too much and past leg
Tossed up full on off, Green taps it square on the offside and takes a quick single
Another length ball cut away to deep point for a brace
On a length on middle and off, Green cuts it away to deep backward point and picks up a couple
Green goes downtown. It's in the slot on middle and Green clears his front leg and muscles this over long-on. Mumbai Indians need more of that!
Darts it in quick on a length around off, Kishan works it out to long-on
Tossed up outside off, Kishan steps forward and gets it off the inside half of the bat towards deep midwicket
Tosses it up full on off, Green slices it in front of point
Oh beauty! On a length on off and through his defence
Oh that would have been some effort! Green smacks it back at him and he gets a foot to it. The ball shoots up and hits his hand, but that would be too difficult to call a chance
On a length outside leg, Kishan moves leg-side himself and heaves it away through midwicket to the fielder
Legbreak on a length on off, Kishan defends to the off side
Another wrong'un, this time punched past short cover to mid-off
Starts off with a quick wrong'un on a length on middle and off, Green punches it to backward point
Dug in short around off, Green pulls it away along the ground to deep midwicket
On a length on middle and Kishan punches it to backward point, who does well to get a hand on it. Little runs in from deep third to cover
Length ball on leg again, this time it stays straighter. Kishan nudges it fine on the leg side and gets a couple
Finally, Kishan gets one away. Length ball on leg and he heaves it away over midwicket. Couple of bounces and it rolls away to the ropes
Fuller on leg and moving across. Kishan punches it to short cover
Oh what a beauty! Shami goes length on middle and leg and Kishan looks to defend but it nips away past the outside edge. This one was at 143kph
Green backs away again and Hardik bowls it wide of off and takes the pace off. Green doesn't go for the shot in the end. What an opening spell from him so far, even though this over went for 12
Rip-snorter from Hardik! Bangs it in short on leg and flies past Green as he looks to pull but it beats Saha too and races away for four byes

Has another go but gets a leading edge that just clears point running backwards! This was on a length outside leg at 143kph and Green had again gotten legside of the ball as he looks to go through the off-side again. Doesn't get the connection this time, but clears the infield
Green breaks the shackles. This was slightly slower from Hardik, 140kph though, but it was full and Green can back away and whack it over long-off
Cuts through him! Banged in short of good length on middle at 145kph again and this time Green looks to pull but is thoroughly beaten
Hardik bangs it in short outside off at 145.4kph. Green had backed away leg side but gets nothing but air with a wild heave
Back of a length outside off, Green moves leg side to make room and belt it through the off side but gets an inside edge through fine leg
Kishan finally gets bat on ball! On a length on leg, this time it ends up closer to off and Kishan punches it to deep backward point
Beats him fourth ball in a row. It's back of a length on leg and going across him. Kishan looks to cut but it goes over
Oh that's a beauty! Bangs it in back of a length on middle and leg and the ball veers away sharply past the outside edge again. Shami gives Kishan a little stare as well
Full and wide this time, Kishan has a swipe but misses
On a length on off and it goes past the outside edge

Hiiiiigh in the air and Hardik makes no mistake as he gets his opposite number. Rohit moves leg-side to this length ball on middle and leg. The ball is swinging in but straightens after pitching and Rohit jabs at it. The ball takes a leading edge and goes high in the air and with many fielders converging Hardik calls for it, settles under it and takes the catch
Oh, beaten. Bangs it in short at 136kph and it goes over Rohit's bat as he tries to cut
On a length outside off and Rohit again defends square on the off side
Kishan steers it through to deep third to get off the mark
Back of length outside off, Rohit pulls it square and takes off for a single and makes it safely even though there's a direct hit at the non-striker's end
Fuller side of good length outside off, Rohit taps it and the ball goes towards short third
Fired in on a length on middle and off again and this time Kishan leaves
Oh, beauty! On a length on middle and it jags away from Ishan Kishan who pokes at it
On a length on off, Ishan Kishan defends
Back of a length outside off, Rohit steers it to deep third and gets off the mark
Rohit comes down the track to a length ball outside off but gets an inside edge onto his foot and the ball rolls back to Shami
Fuller and closer to off this time. There's that outswing again and Rohit defends towards cover
Shami starts off with a full and wide delivery shaping away from Rohit, who has a swipe at it but misses. It's called wide by the umpire
